body: **Describe the bug** execute : alpasim_wizard +deploy=local wizard.log_dir=$PWD/tutorial can't download docker image, docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04 Is the image private? **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Go to 'alpasim' direcotry 2. source setup_local_env.sh 3. export HF_TOKEN=my HF token' 4. export ALPAMAYO_S3_SECRET="1234567" 5. alpasim_wizard +deploy=local wizard.log_dir=$PWD/tutorial 6. ERROR [controller-0 internal] load metadata for docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04 30.0s **Expected behavior** simulator run **Screenshots** **Desktop (please complete the following information):** - OS: PRETTY_NAME="Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS" NAME="Ubuntu" VERSION_ID="24.04" VERSION="24.04.3 LTS (Noble Numbat)" - Nvidia driver/CUDA version (e.g. from `nvidia-smi`): - NVIDIA-SMI 580.95.05 Driver Version: 580.95.05 CUDA Version: 13.0 **Additional context** Add any other context about the problem here. same error by running below command directly: docker compose -f docker-compose.yaml --profile sim up
